# iosxe_voice_class_sip_header_passthrulist (Data Source)

This data source can read the Voice Class SIP Header Passthrulist configuration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "iosxe_voice_class_sip_header_passthrulist" "example" {
  tag = 100
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `tag` (Number) Voice class sip-hdr-passthrulist tag

### Optional

- `device` (String) A device name from the provider configuration.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The path of the retrieved object.
- `passthru_hdr_unsupp` (Boolean) Enable the pass-thru of all unsupported headers
- `passthru_headers` (Set of String) Add hdr in the list of hdrs to be passed thru
